title: I've been stuck in the same dreamspace for over a year.
content: and I've not found a way out yet. There's two malls, one open aired, the other roofed. The only space in the open air mall I really interact with is a bookstore with a small coffee shop/music venue in the front for kids too young to get into bars, and a musical instrument room off to the side. The sealed mall is mostly empty, dark like Edinburgh stone, and has a triskelion layout. My family owns some sort of gardening/nursery store there. The worst place is the Walmart, as it never really changes and I'm there constantly. The most interesting part is the western side, which is a superhighway for flying cars traversing from the north where the guns and electronics are kept, to the south where the registers are. It's about five miles long, so dimensions are relative in this space. If you keep going you end up in a fly in movie theater, but I don't think they ever changed the movie from some 80s romcom. There's a river in front and a space with rdr2 style rolling hills in the center. Different exits in the store lead to different parts of my dream world. The front exit leads to a nasty, rotting, charred version of the streets I grew up on and the side exit to the place I live now. Somewhere on the periphery there are triangular hay fields with white scaffold structures. Something really sinister happens here but I've never been able to communicate with the people who run it. They're always hiding when I'm there. It's right at the boundary of the world. I'm starting to wonder if I have been magically bound inside my skull. It's been a year and these spaces aren't fun. They're lonely and boring.
